summary: Small tools that run in a phone browser, one per job, across the building trades. They all share one engine, so adding a trade is a settings change rather than a new app.
license_note: GPL-3.0-only is the host repo's LICENSE, inherited by this surface rather than chosen for it; nothing here narrows or enlarges that grant.
origin: Not a git fork (GitHub reports fork=false), and not the start of its own repo. The toolkit was written on 2026-08-03 inside the older nested-resonance-memory-archive and inherits that repo's GPL-3.0-only licence rather than choosing one. Its Wish It Better spec was copied from the MIT-licensed mrdirno/vibe-cards, and the commit that brought it across says so. The toolkit's wishing well came first; Collage Studio's well was built from it. The well posts to a hosted database outside the repo. The host repo has carried ATTRIBUTION.md since 2025-11-22 and CITATION.cff since its first commit.
origin_audit: Not a git fork (GitHub reports fork=false), and not the origin of its own repo: the toolkit was written inside the pre-existing nested-resonance-memory-archive on 2026-08-03, 282 days after that repo's first commit (2025-10-25). Its GPL-3.0-only is INHERITED from a LICENSE committed the day the archive was created, not chosen for this project. It implements the Wish It Better spec authored in the MIT-licensed mrdirno/vibe-cards, another entry on this registry, and the commit that brought the spec across says so in its own body -- "WISH_IT_BETTER.md comes from mrdirno/vibe-cards under MIT. MIT into GPL-3.0-only is the direction that is allowed to flow; nothing here goes back the other way" -- while the manifest created in that SAME commit declared origin: null. The provenance and the denial were written by one commit, which is the sharpest instance of why this field needed a gate. It is the younger of the repo's two listed surfaces (COLLAGE-001 was born 2026-01-01) but the DONOR of the shared wishing-well runtime, not its debtor: shared/toolkit.js predates shared/feedback.js by about a day and feedback.js describes itself as the toolkit's own well with the trade assumptions removed. The well posts to a hosted third-party Postgres backend rather than to anything in the repo. The host repo has shipped ATTRIBUTION.md at its root since 2025-11-22 and CITATION.cff since its first commit.
_note: Per-surface manifest, one of two on this repo's Pages site — the other is /collage/wish-it-better.json, and the repo's own stays at the root. It exists because origin (criterion 5 of the Wish It Better network) is a property of each listed surface, not of the repo: the toolkit and Collage Studio have different lineages, and one file copied to both urls could carry only one, which is what the root manifest did until 2026-08-19 and what the network sweep in mrdirno/vibe-cards reported as unclosable. Level L0, not L1, for the two reasons the root manifest records: the toolkit-gates harnesses do not run in the deploy workflow, and the well has no expiry. `origin` here is kept byte-identical by hand to the registry entry AV-TOOLKIT-001 in mrdirno/vibe-cards src/site/network.json, because the sweep compares the two; the long record sits under origin_audit and is not compared.
